title: 选择的悖论
text:
在现代社会中，人们普遍认为拥有更多选项意味着更高的自由度。无论是购物、职业规划还是社交方式，海量的信息让机会看似无穷无尽。然而，这种丰盈往往带来意想不到的心理负担。当个体面对过多替代方案时，决策过程变得异常复杂。
人们在挑选时容易陷入过度分析的陷阱。为了寻找最优解，我们投入大量时间对比细微差别，结果反而增加了焦虑感。即便最终做出了决定，心中也常伴随着对未选择选项的遗憾。这种心理状态导致了满意度的下降，即便结果其实相当不错。
消费主义进一步加剧了这一矛盾。商家通过多样化的产品线营造一种掌控感，实际上却在消耗消费者的认知资源。在这种环境下，简单的快乐被复杂的权衡所取代。人们不再关注需求本身，而是在比较中迷失了方向。
这种现象在数字化时代尤为明显。算法推荐虽然精准，却将用户禁锢在无数个微小分支里。过多的可能性导致了行动力的瘫痪，使人难以做出果断抉择。
因此，学会适度限制选择至关重要。建立清晰的价值标准，能帮助我们过滤掉无关紧要的干扰。意识到完美选择并不存在，是缓解精神内耗的关键。真正的自由并非拥有所有选项，而是能够从容地接纳自己的决定。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what unexpected effect does having many options often bring, despite seeming like more freedom?
options: Guaranteed higher satisfaction with every choice
An unexpected psychological burden
Consistently faster decision-making
Lower prices for consumers overall

questions.prompt: According to the text, what often accompanies people even after they make a final decision among many options?
options: Complete satisfaction with no lingering doubts
Regret over the options they did not choose
Immediate forgetting of all the alternatives
A strong desire to buy even more products

questions.prompt: According to the text, how do merchants' diversified product lines actually affect consumers, despite creating a "sense of control"?
options: They consistently lower prices for consumers
They eliminate the need for consumer decision-making entirely
They consume/drain the consumer's cognitive resources
They have no real effect on consumers at all

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does an excess of possibilities (too many choices) ultimately lead to?
options: Faster, more confident decisions overall
A paralysis of action, making decisive choice difficult
Complete indifference toward choosing anything
An increase in physical exercise habits

questions.prompt: According to the text's conclusion, what does true freedom actually consist of?
options: Having access to literally every possible option
Never having to make any decisions at all
The ability to calmly accept one's own decision
Always choosing the most expensive option available

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
